original_test_intent: With the CPU in the approved BIOS performance profile, apply a bounded CPU workload under controlled cooling and verify that the intended BMC CPU threshold event—if the test is designed to cross it—has the project-defined sensor, direction and severity, without forcing an unsafe thermal excursion.
original_method: Select the unique row; identify SUT, CPU/socket/sensors, BIOS/BMC/OS and cooling; record current BIOS profile and obtain target/rollback; define exact stress-ng stressor/workers/affinity/duration and whether the goal is normal-load no-event or a safe threshold crossing; preserve baseline SEL and telemetry without clearing; enter BIOS via approved console, apply performance mode and activate/reboot as documented; verify OS readiness; start synchronized CPU temperature/frequency/power/fan and SEL capture; run one bounded workload with hard aborts; stop/cool down; decode new CPU event sensor/type/assert/deassert/severity/timing; restore/finalize BIOS and verify health.
manual_activity: An operator applies/restores the approved BIOS performance profile and supervises cooling/abort controls; the agent may run only the exact authorized bounded workload and collect synchronized telemetry/SEL.
required_inputs: SUT, CPU model/socket topology, BIOS/BMC/OS firmware and CPU sensor-to-SEL mapping
Exact BIOS performance setting path/current/target/activation/rollback and final desired state
Exact stress-ng version, stressor, workers, affinity, duration, warm-up/repetitions and command
Whether event assertion is required; sensor threshold/hysteresis, expected SEL event type/severity/assert/deassert/timing and maximum safe temperature/power/fan/error limits
safety_requirements: Use a dedicated drained DUT with verified fans/pumps/ambient and independent console
Back up/record BIOS state and prove performance mode applied before load
Monitor CPU package/core temperature, frequency, power, throttling, fan/pump and host/BMC errors continuously
Abort below vendor hard limits on cooling fault, throttle/error escalation, hang or unexpected power event
Do not clear SEL, disable protection, obstruct cooling, invent/unbound workload or repeat after an abnormal run
agent_execution_scope: Collect synchronized baseline and live read-only telemetry/SEL/logs
After explicit approval, run one exact bounded stress-ng command and enforce supplied abort thresholds
Diff/decode only new CPU threshold events and correlate them with load/telemetry
Do not choose BIOS/load/threshold settings, intentionally overheat, clear evidence, retry or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Approve BIOS profile and rollback/final state
Approve exact stress command and safe thermal/power envelope
Approve whether threshold assertion is expected and the precise SEL sensor/type/severity/hysteresis/timing oracle
Approve cooldown, aborts and console/recovery; review evidence and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The proposed stress-ng/IPMI workflow matches the source at a high level, but no executable stress parameters or target severity exist and 'long-running' contradicts the 5/5-minute estimate without a defined duration.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain stress-ng as the required tool but do not construct a command until engineering supplies stressor/workers/affinity/duration; then execute one bounded run with synchronized telemetry and complete pre/post SEL diff.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: BIOS performance mode, CPU stress-ng, BMC SEL threshold severity and 5/5-minute estimate remain as constraints; no unstated load recipe is invented.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Establish one sensor-specific threshold oracle, synchronize stress/load telemetry with SEL assertion/deassertion and keep the workload inside vendor safety limits while proving BIOS profile and final restoration.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact load/thermal/event semantics, continuous telemetry, bounded aborts, baseline preservation, cooldown and BIOS recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A generic CPU stress summary plus any SEL line cannot prove the event belongs to the correct sensor, crossed the intended threshold or has the required severity; absence may simply reflect insufficient load.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Normal stress may never cross a threshold on adequate cooling; deliberately defeating cooling to force an event is a different, much higher-risk fault-injection test and is not authorized by this row.

project_override_considerations: Engineering must decide whether the case expects a threshold event to assert under performance-mode stress or only validates severity if an event occurs. If safe stress cannot reach the threshold, use a separately approved vendor sensor-injection method or record the coverage limitation; never overheat by improvisation.
expected_evidence: Approved BIOS before/target/active/final state and console/reboot timeline
Exact stress-ng version/command/affinity/duration and one-shot approval
Complete baseline/post SEL and decoded new CPU sensor/type/severity/assert/deassert/timing
Abort/cooldown/final health/BIOS restoration and no-log-clear/no-repeat audit

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2249 Wistron-BMC Sanity-00031-V001: approve the SUT/CPU/socket/sensor/BIOS/BMC/OS/cooling configuration; exact BIOS performance path/current/target/activation/rollback/final state; stress-ng version/stressor/workers/affinity/duration/warm-up/repetitions; decide whether threshold assertion is required or severity is conditional; define SEL sensor/type/assert/deassert/severity/hysteresis/timing, synchronized telemetry, safe temperature/power/fan/error aborts, cooldown and console recovery.

review_improvement: Preserves the BIOS-performance and stress-to-SEL coverage while preventing an undefined workload or unsafe overheating from being used to manufacture a severity event.
independent_technical_reasoning: CPU threshold severity can only be evaluated if the event is tied to a known sensor and controlled crossing. Performance mode changes power/thermal behavior, while stress-ng parameters determine whether load is sufficient and safe. A well-cooled system may correctly produce no threshold event, so the acceptance model must say whether assertion is mandatory or merely checks severity when present. This ambiguity is an engineering oracle requirement, not permission to increase load or impair cooling until an event appears.
